name: Heart of Snow
source:
Titania was determined to pay him back if it was the last thing she did. Khanda Oscuro, the mage that had murdered her mother and set her on a path for revenge. At least until Lumi showed up, all mischief and smiles. Together they travel across Zaminius seeking adventure and companionship in this medieval fantasy.

Heart of Snow is a kinetic visual novel set primarily in a medieval fantasy version of the Middle East, during the Islamic Golden Age. Here you play as Titania, a snow leopard sword fighter, as she is accompanied by Lumi, a 10-year old human kid. Eventually, you are presented with one choice: to continue seeking revenge to the detriment of all else, or become a mother to Lumi, an orphaned slave, and rebuild what you lost at your mother's death. 

[From [url=https://hazel-eagle.itch.io/heart-of-snow]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
泰坦妮娅决心回报他，如果这是她做的最后一件事的话。坎达·奥斯库罗（Khanda Oscuro），谋杀了她母亲并让她走上复仇之路的法师。至少在卢米出现之前，都是恶作剧和微笑。他们一起穿越扎米尼乌斯，在这个中世纪的奇幻世界中寻求冒险和陪伴。

《雪之心》是一部动态视觉小说，主要以伊斯兰黄金时代的中世纪奇幻中东为背景。在这里，你扮演雪豹剑斗士泰坦妮娅，陪伴她的是10岁的人类孩子卢米。最终，你面临一个选择：继续寻求复仇，不惜一切代价，或者成为孤儿奴隶卢米的母亲，并重建你因母亲去世而失去的一切。

[来自[url=https://hazel-eagle.itch.io/heart-of-snow]itch.io[/url]]
